## History

Theodora Dix is a neighbor living near [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) in [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) boards with Miss [Janet](../character/janet.md) Sweet. She is involved in a long-standing elderly romance in the area. [Anne](../character/anne.md) observes her ongoing romance from afar while maintaining a vow not to interfere in the relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P1](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0001), [v3 ch.Again P2](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0002), [v3 ch.Again P3](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0003), [v3 ch.Again P4](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0004), [v3 ch.Again P5](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0005), [v3 ch.Again P8](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0008), +80 more_

## Relationships

### [Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/ludovic-speed--theodora-dix.md)

[Ludovic Speed](../character/ludovic-speed.md) is involved in a long-standing, elderly romance with Theodora Dix, having courted her for an extended period of time. Although their relationship is an ongoing local affair near [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road), it is notable enough that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) observes it while boarding at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside), though [Anne](../character/anne.md) resolves not to meddle in their romance.

- Romantically involved with — courting her for a long time  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 ch.Anne-girl P19](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0019), [v3 ch.People P19](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0019), +1 more</sub>
